title: Victory for football? Spain beat Argentina to win World Cup
facts: Spain defeated Argentina to win the 2026 men's World Cup final in New Jersey.
Ferran Torres scored the match-winning goal in extra time for Spain against Argentina.
Spanish midfielder Rodri captained and lifted the World Cup trophy for Spain.
Spain won its second men's World Cup title by defeating Argentina.
Spain recorded 65% possession and had 11 shots on target during the final against Argentina.
Spain goalkeeper Unai Simon won the Golden Glove award as the tournament's best goalkeeper.
Unai Simon recorded seven clean sheets in eight matches during the 2026 World Cup tournament.
Spain conceded only one goal throughout the entire 2026 World Cup tournament.
The Spain men's national team extended their unbeaten streak to 38 matches across all competitions.
Pau Cubarsi completed 121 passes during the 2026 World Cup final.
Pau Cubarsi, aged 19, was named the young player of the tournament at the 2026 World Cup.
Lamine Yamal became the third-youngest player and third-youngest winner in World Cup final history at 19 years and six days old.
Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez made 11 saves during the 2026 World Cup final.
Argentina became the first team in World Cup history not to register a shot during the standard 90 minutes of a final.
Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez was sent off after receiving two yellow cards during the final.
